text:
priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the Q3 runtime performance scope. Proposing three parallel bets: 1) kernel selection + microkernel optimizations, 2) adaptive quantization rollout, 3) KV cache prefix eviction + hot-key protections. Who wants lead/owner for each?

mike: I can own kernels. plan is to get a minimal gated canary by mid-July. gates: p95 <= 120ms on stub workload, CPU overhead < 8% for batching.

alexa: I'll take KV cache. immediate asks: define telemetry (hit rate, eviction time, tail lat). I want a small experiment: per-customer prefix cache + LRU -> measure p99 delta.

dennison: FYI customer ask from Acme: deterministic tail latency is the blocker for their rollout. they want p95 < 150ms for 8k token sequences. putting that in "customer-driven" column.

eva: adaptive quantization: we should prioritize a fallback path for hallucination regressions. propose automated eval: 200 prompt set, quality delta max 2% BLEU-like metric. rollout if pass.

priya: Good. Also we need cross-cutting launch criteria: (a) perf gates per workload (stub/long/embedding), (b) A/B quality check with canary routing, (c) rollback policy + circuit-breaker. I'll draft a checklist.

mike: question — for kernel work, do we target a single vendor first? prefer NVIDIA cuBLAS + Triton kernels for speed, but need vendor-agnostic fallback.

alexa: KV experiments can run on CPU edge nodes before full GPU integration. will instrument: `kv_hit_rate`, `evictions_per_min`, `avg_kv_lookup_ms`.

dennison: Can we add an acceptance item: "no customer-visible >20% p99 regressions vs baseline". Acme will fail rollout otherwise.

eva: Agreed. Also require regression dashboard with prompt-level diffs before rollout.

sre-bot: NOTE: upcoming infra freeze July 20-24 for region migration. plan around that for canaries.

priya: Action items: Mike -> kernels spec + perf harness (due 07/10). Alexa -> KV telemetry + small A/B plan (due 07/08). Eva -> quant eval suite + rollback criteria (due 07/12). Dennison -> compile customer requirement doc (Acme + two pilots) (due 07/06). I'll consolidate checklist after these land.

mike: :thumbsup: starting perf harness now, will push a prototype PR to `perf/harness-kernels` by EOD Thursday.

alexa: scheduling KV bench runs for Monday, will share dashboards in #perf-dash.

dennison: adding Acme notes to drive doc, pinging solutions-eng to join.

eva: building eval harness with small prompt set, sharing results in thread.

priya: Great — next sync Friday 10am. If anything blocks, post here.

mike: one more thing — we should agree on a cost budget threshold for quantization changes (token-cost delta). otherwise finance will veto.

priya: noted. will loop in finance after specs.

sre-bot: Canary window suggestion: avoid infra freeze window; recommended dates 07/01-07/14.

alexa: ok locking dates, will coordinate with SRE for KV canary. :rocket:
